column1: # The judgement of audit-hachi-lang-sh-d (2026-11-03, written for this pack, GPL-3.0-or-later): frequent words of
# sr_50k's top 10,000 whose Cyrillic first result was wrong while the Latin one is right, and whose Cyrillic
# form-of rows name the right lemma. Judged by the dominant use; the first lemma a rule reaches gets a Cyrillic
# twin in sources/build-own.mjs (ekavian first for Serbian Cyrillic). word<TAB>dominant lemma(s)<TAB>the wrong
# Cyrillic first result<TAB>the transform group of the twin, where no single rule reaches the lemma
# (the Latin word reaches it through its own references)
# Judged by this pack's author (written for this pack, GPL-3.0-or-later) from the Cyrillic-against-Latin sample of the
# Gutenberg texts (README, Measurements 4), as audit-hachi-lang-sh-d pointed out: words outside the top 10,000 whose
# Cyrillic first result is wrong while the Latin one is right, and whose Cyrillic rows name the right lemma. праве is
# left out: its sample position wants прав ("праве и криве линије"), but 7 of Tatoeba's 8 sentences with the word use
# Judged by this pack's author (written for this pack, GPL-3.0-or-later) from a Latin-against-Cyrillic scan of the
# 10,000 most frequent words of hr_50k and sr_50k at the head after the twins above (audit-hachi-lang-sh-d's
# cyr-breakable.py): the words still wrong in Cyrillic, right in Latin, whose Cyrillic rows name the right lemma and
# whose dominant reading is clear. lemma:adj names the adjective rules (dobrom is also a noun rule's dobar).
# одаје is left out: its noun одаја "chamber" is 5 of the 7 uses in the two measured texts, the verb in subtitles.
